testCase.name: [dev] S16 Double tap on the In Today toggle: the toggle ends where two taps put it, and the dashboard agrees

descriptionHtml:
缺陷 B30 · P2 · 已知

快速双击 In Today 开关会丢一次点击，点完住户反而不在今天的名单里

票：TFA-92587 AC2 ready for qa · 算 QA bug：是 · 在哪发现：dev

思路 / Approach · TC-20 Rounding Dashboard · S16 「在 In Today 切换上双击：切换最后停在点两下该在的地方，dashboard 也一致」 Double tap on the In Today toggle: the toggle ends where two taps put it, and the dashboard agrees

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U5 Nursing Home counts are based on the residents marked 'In Today'. Marking a resident adds them to the counts. Un-marking removes them from today's counts without deleting them from All Residents（UAT TC-09；TFA-92598 AC 4；TFA-92587 AC 6；TFA-92587 AC 2）

测试设计方法：错误推测（error-guessing） — 专门去撞最容易出错的地方（失败、重复点、两个标签页、时钟不对、注入的指令）。

Given Standard fixture; resident In Today

When On All Residents, double-click the resident's In Today toggle with one browser_click call using doubleClick: true, then open the dashboard

Then Two taps are two toggles, so the resident ends In Today: the toggle reads 'In Today' (not '+ Today') and the dashboard counts the resident (Total 1). No tap is lost

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：TFA-92587 AC 1 ('working In Today / + Today toggle'). List checkpoint: mustContain the resident and 'In Today', mustNotContain '+ Today'. This reads the resident's own toggle in the AC 1 wording; with one resident on the account, no other '+ Today' shows on All Residents. …

在哪跑：dev 单元 U56；测试方法 AGENT · 浏览器 agent；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（automated）

S16 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-20.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条；Allure 状态按分诊从 broken 改成 failed。

问题分类：已知产品问题 · 环境 dev · 票 TFA-92587 ready for qa；TFA-92598 in progress

快速双击住户的 In Today 开关会丢一次点击，两次点完住户反而不在今天的名单里。

A quick double tap on a resident's In Today toggle loses one tap, so the resident ends up off today's list when the two taps should have left them on it.

依据：allure-results/d0836fed…: ledger #56 (U56, checked). A double tap on 'In Today ✓' leaves inTodaysSession=false and the button flips back to '+ Today': one tap is lost. Dev report §2 #8 (TFA-92587 AC 2, ready for qa). The dashboard still counting the resident is the S04a root.

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：AGENT · 浏览器 agent；辅助：PW · Playwright 脚本 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
